t: Reflex-Korelle | Camerapedia | Fandom
s: January 9, 2026 - The Reflex-Korelle is a reflex camera made by Franz Kochmann, later Korelle-Werk, Dresden. It is one of the earliest 6×6cm SLRs. The Meister-Korelle is a postwar developement, also sold as the Master Reflex. Copies of the Reflex-Korelle were made in various countries, for example the British Agiflex or the Japanese Reflex Beauty.
